reasons.plausibility: Relying on a stable oxide layer to hinder both dislocation motion and grain‐boundary sliding is scientifically reasonable, though details of how this surface barrier impacts bulk deformation remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of creep rates between coated and uncoated samples at the same temperature and stress conditions is a straightforward and decisive way to test the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a clear mechanistic pathway (oxide formation) and a practical experimental approach that can guide further research and alloy design for improved creep resistance.
